# Lodestone Warps 1.0.0-26.3

Compatibility update for Minecraft Java Edition 26.3.

## Changed

- Updated the Minecraft target from 26.2 to 26.3.
- Updated Fabric Loader to 0.19.5.
- Updated Fabric API to 0.160.5+26.3.
- Updated Fabric Loom and Gradle for the 26.3 toolchain.

## Notes

- Existing Lodestone Warps configuration and saved warp data remain compatible.
- Java 25 or newer is required.
- Fabric API remains a required dependency.
